case_title: TINA SHIH VS. ROYAL EXPRESS CHARTER AND TOURS INC

docket_entries.description: EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED APR-01-2009 ORDERED DESTROYED
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-30-2008 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SHIH, TINA IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT ROYAL EXPRESS CHARTER AND TOURS INC FROM THE TESTIMONY AND EVIDENCE SUBMITTED, THE COURT DETERMINES THAT THE TRUCK THAT STRUCK THE REAR OF DEFENDANT'S BUS WAS THE SOLE CAUSE OF THE COLLISION. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,500.00 FILED BY SHIH, TINA AS TO DEFENDANT ROYAL EXPRESS CHARTER AND TOURS INC ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-03-2008 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
DECLARATION OF PLTF THAT DEFT HAS NOT BEEN SERVED WITH HE CLAIM. FILED BY PLAINTIFF SHIH, TINA
TRIAL RESET TO DEC-30-2008 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506 TRIAL OF DEC-03-2008 IS TAKEN OFF CALENDAR
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED SERVED NOV-20-2000, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT ROYAL EXPRESS CHARTER AND TOURS INC
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT ROYAL EXPRESS CHARTER AND TOURS INC

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-30-2008 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-30-2008 BY PAUL SLAVIT. APPEARANCES BY BOTH PARTIES. EXHIBITS RETAINED. PLAINTIFF'S DAUGHTER JULIE WONG INTERPRETS ENGLISH/MANDARIN - MANDARIN/ENGLISH ON HER BEHALF. TOM LAM INTERPRETS ENGLISH/MANDARIN - MANDARIN/ENGLISH ON DEFENDANT'S BEHALF. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506).
